query:
SELECT 
  MONTH(o.deliveryDate) as delivery_month,
  op.productName,
  op.color,
  SUM(op.quantity) as total_qty
FROM orders o
JOIN orderProducts op ON o.id = op.orderId
WHERE o.deliveryDate >= '2026-06-01' AND o.deliveryDate < '2026-09-01'
AND o.status != 'cancelled'
AND (op.productName LIKE '%UP920%' OR op.productName LIKE '%UP911%')
GROUP BY MONTH(o.deliveryDate), op.productName, op.color
ORDER BY MONTH(o.deliveryDate), op.productName, op.color;
